title: Microsoft Teams: pop out calls into a separate window in the browser
summary: The briefing passes. Its rollout, browser support and automatic arrival match Microsoft's notice, and its licensing follows the documented Teams requirement. Independent searches found no documented admin control or licence or meter specific to this call window.

Read meeting-policies-overview; searched settings-policies-reference, Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy. No matching control; PSTN URL pop-out and Edge video-overlay settings differ.
